# Norric

> The EU data rail for agents: official European company-register data over MCP and x402.

## Canonical machine links

- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.norric.io/mcp
- Health: https://mcp.norric.io/health
- OpenAPI: https://norric.io/openapi.json
- Human + agent guide: https://norric.io/docs
- Facilitator: https://x402-facilitator-production-5948.up.railway.app/
- Network: Base Sepolia testnet (`eip155:84532`) only. Mainnet is blocked.
- MCP Registry: `io.github.gucceed/norric-mcp`

## Coverage

Official national registers only: Bolagsverket (Sweden), CVR (Denmark),
Brønnøysund (Norway), PRH (Finland).

- Sweden: live and queryable.
- Denmark, Norway and Finland: paid routes live in production; data coverage
  rolls out as each national pipeline completes its first load. Do not treat
  DK/NO/FI company data as queryable until `norric_data_freshness_v1` shows
  live sources for those countries.
- Estonia and France: code-complete and payment-gated. They open to queries
  after their first national loads complete.

The rail is EU-resident end to end: official EU sources, the production
database in Stockholm, and compute plus the payment facilitator in Amsterdam.

## Zero-onboarding discovery

Connect to the MCP endpoint without an API key, send `initialize`, retain the
`mcp-session-id`, then send `tools/list`. Discovery is free. These tools are free:

- `norric_status_v1`
- `norric_data_freshness_v1`

The first wallet-paid tools are `swedish_company_verify_v1` and
`finnish_company_verify_v1` at 2,000 atomic test USDC ($0.002 nominal, the
trust anchor), plus `swedish_company_changes_v1` and
`finnish_company_changes_v1` at 20,000 ($0.02, the changes feed). An unpaid `tools/call` returns an x402 v2
challenge. Sign the accepted exact payment with the agent wallet, put the
payload at `params._meta["x402/payment"]`, and retry the same call. The
response includes `_meta["x402/payment-response"]` with settlement details. No
API key or human account is needed. Other tools remain unavailable anonymously
until assigned a price band.

Approved exact price bands (atomic test USDC): lookup 2,000; signal 5,000;
evidence 10,000; feed/batch 20,000; heavy synthesis 50,000. Wired today:
Swedish and Finnish company verify (lookup band) and company changes feeds
(feed/batch band). Watchlist/event metering is not yet live.

## Muse Code

```json
{
  "mcp_servers": {
    "norric": {
      "transport": "streamable_http",
      "url": "https://mcp.norric.io/mcp",
      "enabled": true,
      "mode": "optional"
    }
  }
}
```

Ask Muse to list Norric tools, call free status/freshness, then use an x402-capable
wallet client for paid calls. API-key clients remain supported for existing use.

## Safety and data status

Some of the 42 registered functions are partial or inactive while upstream
pipelines are disconnected. Check status and freshness before consequential use;
do not treat warning-bearing or placeholder results as live intelligence. Tools
degrade honestly (found=false with warnings) rather than guessing.
